title: Library Rules
text: The central library is open from 8 AM to 8 PM on Monday to Friday and from 10 AM to 4 PM on Saturday. The library remains closed on Sundays and public holidays. During exam weeks the weekday closing time is extended to 11 PM.

title: Library Rules
text: Students may borrow up to 5 books at a time for a period of 21 days. Books can be renewed once if no other student has reserved them. A late fine of Rs. 2 per day is charged for every overdue book. Lost books must be replaced or paid for at the current market price.

title: Examination Policy
text: A student must have at least 75 percent attendance in every course to be eligible to sit the end-semester examination. Students with attendance between 65 and 75 percent may apply for condonation with a valid medical certificate and a fee of Rs. 500.

title: Assignment Policy
text: Assignments submitted after the deadline lose 5 percent of the total marks for each day of delay. Submissions more than 5 days late are not accepted and receive zero marks. Extensions must be requested in writing from the course instructor before the deadline.

title: Academic Integrity
text: All written work is checked with similarity detection software. A similarity score above 25 percent is referred to the academic integrity committee for review. Confirmed plagiarism results in zero marks for the work, and repeated offences may lead to suspension for one semester.

title: IT Services
text: Students can connect to the campus Wi-Fi network named RC-Campus using their student email and portal password. Each student may register up to 3 devices. Connection problems should be reported to the IT helpdesk, which is open from 9 AM to 5 PM on working days.

title: IT Services
text: Passwords must contain at least 12 characters including one number and one symbol. Passwords expire every 180 days and must be changed on the student portal. Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for all staff accounts and recommended for students.

title: Fee Payment
text: Semester tuition fees are due by the 15th of August for the odd semester and by the 15th of January for the even semester. Payments made after the due date attract a late fee of 2 percent of the outstanding amount for each month. Fees can be paid online through the student portal or at the accounts office.

title: Scholarships
text: The merit scholarship covers 50 percent of tuition fees for students who maintain a CGPA of 8.5 or higher in the previous academic year. Applications must be submitted to the scholarship office by 30 September along with the previous year's grade card.

title: Hostel Rules
text: Hostel residents must return to the hostel by 10 PM. Visitors are allowed only in the visitors' lounge between 4 PM and 6 PM on weekends. Overnight guests are not permitted under any circumstances.

title: Leave Policy
text: Students who miss classes due to illness must submit a medical certificate to the department office within 3 days of returning to college. Medical leave is approved by the head of department and does not by itself waive the attendance requirement.

title: Grievance Redressal
text: Complaints can be submitted through the grievance box or the online grievance form. The grievance committee acknowledges every complaint within 2 working days and gives a written response within 10 working days. Complaints about harassment are handled confidentially.

title: Laboratory Safety
text: Students must wear closed footwear and lab coats inside all laboratories. Food and drinks are strictly prohibited in laboratory rooms. Any accident or equipment damage must be reported to the lab instructor immediately.

title: Placement Cell
text: To participate in campus placements a student must have a CGPA of at least 6.5 and no active backlogs. Students must register with the placement cell by the end of the sixth semester and upload an updated resume.

title: Student ID Card
text: A lost or damaged student ID card can be replaced at the administration office. The replacement fee is Rs. 200 and a copy of the police complaint or an affidavit is not required. A new card is issued within 3 working days.

title: Examination Policy
text: Students may apply for re-evaluation of an answer script within 7 days of the publication of results. The fee is Rs. 500 per paper. The revised marks replace the original marks only if they are higher, and the result is announced within 15 days.
